maddeler.e:
أنقشع (form VII)
# أَنْقَشِعُ (ʔanqašiʕu) /ʔan.qa.ʃi.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْقَشَعَ (inqašaʕa)
# أَنْقَشِعَ (ʔanqašiʕa) /ʔan.qa.ʃi.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَشَعَ (inqašaʕa)
# أَنْقَشِعْ (ʔanqašiʕ) /ʔan.qa.ʃiʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْقَشَعَ (inqašaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
